stories.title: Comfort fit for conservancy workers: how three Indian cities are getting the ‘measurements’ right
stories.summary: What does it take to design gloves, masks and uniform that factor in the various challenges faced by workers on the waste beat? Indore, Bengaluru and Pune have an answer The available reporting identifies the immediate development, but further evidence is needed to assess implementation, responses and longer-term consequences.
stories.why_it_matters: The development has direct consequences for residents and public services in the affected area. Clear official information and follow-through will matter more than announcements alone as local impacts become measurable.
stories.evidence_status: The account is based on reporting by The Hindu - States. Official claims, allegations and projections remain attributed; underlying records were not independently reviewed unless a linked report states otherwise.
